subject: How do I connect our Stripe account for member subscriptions?

body: We rebranded our Instagram and LinkedIn handles. Where in the admin dashboard do we update the social media URLs so they show up in our website footer?

body: How do we configure lead auto-matching so when a homeowner submits a request in Dallas, it automatically routes to up to 3 verified roofing contractors?

subject: Please cancel my annual subscription and refund the $1,188 charge

subject: Data export timeout corrupted our customer database

subject: Latest platform update broke our custom CSS navigation bar
